observations:
Torah #101 has a uniquely compressed structure. The entire teaching is organized around a single binary opposition — אנפין נהירין versus אנפין חשוכין — which the Rebbe elaborates across every domain: cognition, national history, spiritual practice, and cosmic ontology. There is no third independent domain in this teaching.

Three candidate clusters were examined for new-package potential:

(1) The חכמה-בינה-דעת triad. One might ask whether the three intellectual faculties form their own independent package. They do not. The Torah's argument makes explicitly clear that חכמה/בינה/דעת = שלש שכליות = ידים לתורה = שלש פעמים יק = אנפין נהירין. Each of these equivalences is stated directly in the source text. The three faculties are not a separate domain — they are the internal structure of אנפין נהירין. Their bechina connections flow into the same node-cluster. This is a case of elaboration-within-a-package, not an independent domain.

(2) The Torah-letters cluster (חמשה חמשי תורה / חמשת מוצאות הפה). One might ask whether 'Torah as speech-letters' constitutes a separate linguistic domain. It does not. The five books = five mouth-positions is a structural identity of Torah with human speech, which is itself an expression of the sekhel-faculty (חכמה creates, the mouth speaks, the Torah is the content). In this Torah, Torah IS אנפין נהירין by direct declaration (Edge 401: תורה ↔ אנפין נהירין). There is no independent 'speech' cluster; speech here is simply another face of Torah-intellect.

(3) The 'yokes' cluster (על מלכות / על דרך ארץ). One might ask whether the political-subjugation and cultural-corruption themes form a separate 'galut' package. They do not. These are explicitly identified as the consequences of abandoning Torah-intellect (אנפין נהירין), i.e., they are manifestations of the dark-face domain taking over. Both nodes are defined as bechinot of אנפין חשוכין's grip (שעבוד בגשמיות = על מלכות and מדות רעות = על דרך ארץ). They are not an independent domain — they are faces of the same dark-face reality that constitutes Package 2.

The three gap additions identified in torah_101_additions.json (סם חיים, סם מות, עיקר שם אדם) would each be assigned to existing packages (Packages 1 and 2 respectively). They do not cluster together into an independent new domain.

Conclusion: Torah #101's radical binary structure means all conceptual nodes in the bechina subgraph are fully accounted for by two packages. No cluster of 3+ concepts with bechina language forms an independent domain not already covered by Package 1 (אנפין נהירין) or Package 2 (אנפין חשוכין).
